items.description: Executed 23 middle-market buy-side and sell-side engagements for businesses with $10M–$50M in revenue across SaaS, professional services, industrials, healthcare and consumer. Flagged ~$450K in potential cash and debt-like adjustments impacting purchase price.

Led 20 mid-market audit engagements across healthcare, energy, mining and construction, from planning and risk assessment through financial statement issuance. Identified ~$325K in inventory valuation adjustments for an industrial client.
Analyzed pricing, margins and operating costs to surface profitability improvements, and optimized procurement and material utilization for roughly $300K in annual cost savings.
Executed quarterly and year-end audits across technology and healthcare clients, and performed SOX walkthroughs, controls and IPE testing over key financial reporting processes for US GAAP.
